serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Incode provides a secure and flexible identity verification platform that enables agencies to strengthen trust, prevent fraud, and modernize how they deliver services to the public. The platform's modular, no-code design allows agencies to configure custom verification flows that include ID validation, face match with liveness, fraud checks, watchlists, and document capture, all within a single streamlined solution. A centralized dashboard provides full visibility and control over sessions, identities, compliance, and user management, simplifying oversight and ensuring accountability. For users, Incode makes identity verification fast and seamless, reducing friction while maintaining the highest security and privacy standards. By combining compliance tools with an intuitive experience for the public, Incode empowers government organizations to achieve zero trust goals while improving efficiency and access to essential services.
